facts.business: Bajaj Housing Finance Limited is a housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank, providing home loans, commercial real estate loans, developer finance, and near prime & affordable housing finance.

auditor.name: Mukund M. Chitale & Co. and Singhi & Co. (Joint Statutory Auditors)

key_risks: Estimation uncertainty in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) on loan assets
Liquidity risk management under stressed scenarios
Concentration in loan portfolio secured by tangible assets
Dependence on wholesale funding and securitisation borrowings
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details are disclosed in Note 46 to the financial statements.
